breakdown.description: The name-consistency check mixes the `Mg_Ga` charge-state group with a Ga-vacancy reference entry.
breakdown.reason: The user's incorrect prompt instructed the agent to check the name consistency of the 'Mg_Ga' group 'together with the Ga-vacancy reference entry'. This would lead to a failed consistency check, as 'Mg_Ga' and 'v_Ga' are different names. The generated specification correctly omits any mention of the Ga-vacancy entry and focuses solely on iterating through the 'Mg_Ga' charge states, which aligns with the ground truth.
